QUOTE: "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` returns `{}`. The only signal is one `logger->error` line (line 65)... Nothing propagates an error code." and "`count_tokens` and the C API `entropic_inference_count_tokens` return `0` too. A caller doing budget math sees "zero tokens" and thinks the prompt fits."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says failure returns an empty vector with no error signal, so it is indistinguishable from a real empty result, and it says callers mostly don't check, e.g. "No empty check exists at these sites".
